ucf_manual_class_prompts_10x.json.name: manual_clip_friendly_10_prompts_per_class
notes: Prompts are rewritten as natural caption-like phrases because CLIP was trained on image-text captions.
Each prompt keeps discriminative visual actions, objects, actors, and scene cues for one UCF-Crime class.
Prompts intentionally use natural function words when they improve caption fluency.

ucf_manual_class_prompts_10x_v2.json.name: manual_clip_friendly_10_prompts_per_class_v2
ucf_manual_class_prompts_10x_v2.json.style: CLIP-friendly surveillance caption prompts with reduced class confusion.
ucf_manual_class_prompts_10x_v2.json.source: Rewritten from manual_caption_10x using manual prompt diagnostics.
notes: This version keeps 10 prompts per class and the same JSON schema as v1.
Fighting, Arrest, Explosion, Arson, Vandalism, and Normal were rewritten most heavily.
Prompts avoid relying on negation and emphasize discriminative visual cues.

ucf_manual_class_prompts_5x_v3.json.name: manual_clip_friendly_5_prompts_per_class_v3
ucf_manual_class_prompts_5x_v3.json.style: CLIP-friendly surveillance caption prompts with stronger class separation.
ucf_manual_class_prompts_5x_v3.json.source: Hybrid rewrite from manual_caption_10x v1 and v2 using manual prompt diagnostics.
design_notes: This version reduces each class from 10 prompts to 5 prompts.
Prompts were selected or rewritten using prompt-level AP, margin, text confusion, and class similarity diagnostics.
Explosion and Arson are separated by instant blast cues versus human ignition and gradual flame growth.
Burglary, Robbery, Stealing, and Shoplifting are separated by forced entry, victim coercion, unattended property, and retail concealment.
Shooting, Assault, Fighting, and Arrest are separated by firearm discharge, one-sided attack, mutual combat, and police custody cues.
Prompts avoid negation-heavy wording because CLIP may not reliably encode negative constraints.

ucf_manual_class_prompts_5x_v4.json.name: manual_clip_friendly_5_prompts_per_class_v4
ucf_manual_class_prompts_5x_v4.json.style: CLIP-friendly surveillance caption prompts with repaired anomaly-class overlap.
ucf_manual_class_prompts_5x_v4.json.source: Rewritten from manual_caption_5x_v3 using v3 prompt diagnostics.
design_notes: This version keeps 5 prompts per class and preserves the v3 training protocol.
Explosion is rewritten to reduce overlap with Arson, Shooting, Fighting, and Vandalism.
Vandalism, Burglary, Robbery, and Stealing are rewritten to reduce property/action overlap.
Arson and RoadAccidents receive small repairs for clearer temporal causes.
Classes that were clean in v3 are kept mostly stable to avoid losing useful signal.
Prompts avoid negation-heavy wording because CLIP may not reliably encode negative constraints.

ucf_manual_class_prompts_5x_v5.json.name: manual_clip_friendly_5_prompts_per_class_v6
ucf_manual_class_prompts_5x_v5.json.style: Semantic-preserving CLIP-friendly surveillance prompts with improved class separation.
design_notes: Prompts preserve anomaly class semantics while emphasizing visible frame-level evidence.
Descriptions avoid excessive temporal reasoning because VadCLIP aligns frame-level visual features.
Similar classes are separated by emphasizing different visual cues and contexts.
Prompts are designed for text-visual similarity analysis.
